en:
## Performance

- Reduced narrator message component overhead to make long conversations scroll more smoothly and mount faster.
- Reworked message layout wrappers with lighter native elements while preserving the existing visual spacing.

## Bug Fixes

- Improved chunked narrator realtime sync for streamed web search, image generation, interrupted runs, selection, and bottom-follow behavior.
- Fixed built-in gateway goal-continuation turns and disabled-provider handling so the gateway adapter does not receive empty prompts or run after being turned off.
- Made update downloads more reliable on Windows, including clearer zstd retry guidance, retry cache bypass, longer helper downloads, and hidden shell windows.
- Raised the default first-token timeout to 5 minutes to reduce premature retries on slow provider responses.
- Simplified NUG model labels so channel routing is easier to scan in model pickers.
zh-CN:
## 性能优化

- 降低叙述者消息渲染的组件开销，让长对话滚动更顺畅、冷挂载更快。
- 使用更轻量的原生元素重做消息布局容器，同时保持原有视觉间距。

## 修复

- 改进 chunk 化叙述者的实时同步，覆盖流式联网搜索、图片生成、中断清理、文本选择和底部跟随行为。
- 修复内置网关适配器的目标延续轮次和禁用 provider 的处理，避免空提示词请求，并确保关闭后聊天与搜索都不会继续调用。
- 提升 Windows 更新下载稳定性，包括更清晰的 zstd 重试提示、显式重试绕过失败缓存、延长辅助工具下载超时并隐藏命令窗口。
- 将首 token 默认超时提高到 5 分钟，减少慢速模型响应被过早重试的问题。
- 简化 NUG 模型标签，让模型选择器中的通道路由更容易辨认。
